name: Harvey's Nine Lives
detailed_description:
Harvey’s Nine Lives is the ultimate feline-fueled adventure! Join Harvey, a bold and brilliant cat archaeologist, as he journeys across time and space to uncover ancient talismans and unlock their powerful secrets.

Leap, claw, and dash your way through richly themed worlds in this fast-paced, side-scrolling platformer. Collect mystical talismans that grant incredible powers—and combine them in creative ways to dominate each level, outscore your rivals, and uncover hidden treasures. Crush enemies underpaw and face off in epic boss battles at the end of every zone.

Each world is packed with unique features and gameplay twists. Slip between dimensions using Torii gates in the Japanese-themed zone, or ride raging sandsharks across golden deserts in the Egyptian level. Want to soar through the skies? Learn to tame and ride dragons at the legendary Dragon Rider Academy!

With heart-pounding action, gorgeous environments, and a clever blend of platforming and puzzle-solving, Harvey’s Nine Lives is more than just a game—it’s a legendary quest across worlds you’ll never want to leave.
